mapping.method: Exact __text instruction decode using retained LIEF 1.0.0/Capstone 5.0.9, LC_FUNCTION_STARTS, task-name/method-string ADRP+ADD references, direct calls and outlined helper instructions. Embedded __const agent payload strings in the host were excluded from host implementation mapping; host __cstring and __text identify the active host copy.
mapping.agent_send: Controller vfunc dispatch -> proxy serializer 0xef024 -> g_dbus_proxy_call_internal 0x16f710 -> connection_call_internal 0x166aec -> send_with_reply_unlocked 0x165c04 -> send_message_unlocked 0x165aa8 -> worker queue at call 0x165b84. Capture serial at 0x165b74 before queue, then boolean/result at 0x165cec. This proves acceptance/queueing only, not stream write completion.
mapping.host_handler: LocalHostSession.prepare_to_exec begin 0x76928 is anchored by exact retained task-name string and direct coroutine call 0x78460. Coroutine state 0 initially queries entry_future; state 1 resumes that await, state 2 resumes prepare_exec_transition. Context task at +0x18. Generated D-Bus handler invokes its abstract interface wrapper at 0x21f754 and supplies callback 0x21fd14 with method context D holding invocation at +0.
mapping.host_completion: Success path at 0x78618 calls helper 0x7a650, completing H through implementation 0xdd7ec8 with Hctx pointer. Generated callback 0x21fd14 runs interface finish, reads error, builds method reply at call through helper 0x228d10 and queues it through connection. Native getter offsets prove invocation connection +0x48, message +0x50. Reply constructor loads original request serial +0x2c. The new reply outgoing serial is distinct from reply_to.
mapping.agent_reply_dispatch: Receive branch at 0x167f38 has selected send task S, reply object, connection and native reply_serial. It calls task return pointer at 0x167f3c. Connection callback 0x16ac80 consumes S and task C; proxy callback 0x171530 consumes C and task P; Runner exec state 2 is final awaited continuation. This splits packet/task delivery from callback dispatch.

Direct name-string searches did not identify tiny stripped message/invocation getters; their fields were established from exact referenced native getter/constructor/helper instructions instead. No absence-of-symbol inference was treated as a capability limit.
No private symbol names or new DWARF/debug symbols recovered. Instruction matches alone are not live behavior proof.
Queued messages are not necessarily written. A host-handler absence after queue acceptance still needs stream-write versus host-receipt/dispatch discrimination; contract explicitly retains this gap.
The original 12-second progress deadline is shorter than default 25-second D-Bus request timeout. Its expiration alone cannot prove a native D-Bus timeout, external defect, or lost reply.
Separate debugger logs cannot establish universal execution order from append order or unrelated monotonic origins. Use causal call sites and explicit task/serial/channel identities.
Source memory/object pointer lifetimes are bounded; do not read Hctx after finish can free it or mistake a reused task pointer for the prior identity.
Initial interpreter queues and fork-only allocation coverage remain unproven. No production fix, dependency modification or lifecycle workaround proposed.

preconditions: One free native macOS ARM64 retained worker, pinned Python 3.12.10 and Frida 17.24.3 exact wheel/binding hashes; use CAT persistent authenticated Upterm before changed commands and preserve same-worker retry/cleanup ownership.

Use exact immutable probe.py/fixture.py/observe.py hashes from accepted native receipt. New scratch host observer/coordinator and revised scratch agent lldb_boundary.py/fingerprints.json are proposed observation harness changes only; parent must authorize their implementation.
Validate actual debugger readiness and every live agent/host image header, UUID and all used instruction/field-layout validation bytes. Names or old ASLR bases are insufficient.

New host launch capability is unproven. First run a bounded import-only control under root LLDB with a pending PyInit__frida breakpoint: launch the same Python environment with import frida only, prove the resolved stop is host base+0x4000, read exact host header/UUID/site bytes, continue and verify terminal exit. It must fail closed on unresolved symbols, mismatches or inability to launch/inspect. Do not consume a fixture arming deadline for this check.
host_setup: Launch the unchanged controller probe.py as the inferior of root LLDB with the original environment, SUDO_UID/SUDO_GID, arguments and controller stdout/stderr file paths. Preserve workload UID 501 and all fixture subprocess descriptors. Use the actual exported PyInit__frida symbol (binary symbol _PyInit__frida=0x4000) to stop after binding mapping, before import returns and before the fixture is spawned.

At that stop, verify the host image and all relevant bytes, arm host handler/state/reply/error sites, then continue normally. No target expression evaluation, target function calls, register writes, Frida lifecycle calls, injected scripts, altered descriptors or new fixture gates.

Start unchanged observe.py alongside the controller launch; it waits for observer_gate_wait and attaches the child as before. Agent observer verifies image/sites and touches the existing debugger-armed file within the unchanged four-second handshake. The host observer must already be armed; do not serially attach a second debugger during this window.

Host/agent debugger callbacks record and auto-continue. They must not synchronously wait on each other or on the controller pump. Correlate their retained records offline by identities. Use each process local sequence; cross-process timestamp or append order is not the authority for causal/lifetime claims.

correlation.selected_request: fixture case + observed child PID + exec coroutine context + controller callback + bounded HostChildInfo(pid,parent_pid,origin,path) + exact method/path/interface + agent connection/request message + request serial
correlation.P: Proxy GTask created at 0x16f764: callback=agent base+0xbf64, userdata=tracked exec context.
correlation.C: Connection-call GTask at 0x166bc4: its callback is agent base+0x171530, userdata=P.
correlation.S: Send-with-reply GTask at 0x165c7c: callback agent base+0x16ac80, userdata=C. Validate outlined frame delta 0x70.
correlation.serial_before_transport: At 0x165b74 capture request serial and message pointer before worker send; require nonzero and native message+0x2c equal w24. This avoids relying on an after-send publication order.
correlation.host: handler x4=D; D+0 invocation; invocation+0x48 host connection; invocation+0x50 original request message; original message+0x2c request serial. HostChildInfo must match child payload. Hctx from handler coroutine holds task H at +0x18. Require a unique request match; duplicate serials on other connections are unrelated, not sufficient matches.
correlation.reply: Generated callback task H and userdata D must match. reply_created links its reply object to the original request. The host outgoing reply message serial is separate from request serial. At agent matched_reply_delivery, require S/connection match and actual native reply_serial==request serial; distinguish type 2 success return from type 3 D-Bus error.
correlation.retirement: Scope identities by case, PID, task role and creation event. Retire S from future error matching when connection callback begins, C when proxy callback begins, P when exec state 2 begins, H when generated host callback begins. Do not infer arbitrary pointer lifetime, read freed coroutine state after finish, or accept a reused address as the old task.

runs: After the new import-only host-observer gate passes, one unchanged inherit control must show the complete correlated chain including all required selected captures, zero observer errors/unreadable fields, request/reply serial match, success completion and full fixture lifecycle. A branch not exercised stays unproven.

Detach child debugger at all_complete before exec, as accepted previously. Host controller does not exec: after recording its selected reply-queued boundary it may detach immediately; do not keep stopping unrelated later calls. Verify both observer terminal states and processes.

Then one unchanged normal close_fds=True diagnostic on the same worker, original deadline. No clean repetition of a conclusive negative. Harness-only failure gets focused incremental correction with original sources/results retained; never weaken matching predicates to make it pass.

Keep error returns distinct from missing callbacks. Any required unmatched identity, unreadable field, unknown state, missing observation, live-byte mismatch, silent log loss or ambiguous request correlation fails its observation gate.

Capture exact commands, sources, hashes, PID tree, logs and failures; collect and verify a manifest archive before removing the owned remote directory. Verify process/debugger absence, SSH terminal result and provider posts before deleting client credentials.
